summary: deliverability-judge skill v0.1.0 — read-only email deliverability signal fusion, published and dogfooded with green harness

harness_cases.name: sealed_healthy_signals_continue
harness_cases.description: Healthy reputation, low bounce, low complaint, passing placement probe → verdict.healthy with recommendation.action continue

harness_cases.name: contradictory_signals_escalate
harness_cases.description: Two signals contradict (high reputation + high bounce) → refusal, no recommendation emitted

dogfood.command: runx skill deltah9420/deliverability-judge@0.1.0 --registry https://api.runx.ai --input evidence=... --input policy=... --json

observations: verdict: state=healthy, confidence_window=7d, reason='All signals sealed, within policy thresholds, and non-contradictory.'
signal postmaster_report: sealed=true, within_policy=true, value=95, threshold=80, source=postmaster.example.com
signal bounce_metrics: sealed=true, within_policy=true, value=1.2, threshold=5, source=bounce-monitor.example.com
signal complaint_metrics: sealed=true, within_policy=true, value=0.05, threshold=0.3, source=feedback-loop.example.com
signal placement_probe: sealed=true, within_policy=true, value=97.5, source=placement-test.example.com

dogfood: package=deltah9420/deliverability-judge@0.1.0, command='runx skill deltah9420/deliverability-judge@0.1.0 --registry https://api.runx.ai --input evidence=... --input policy=... --json', verify_verdict='receipt sealed with Ed25519 signature'
